pages.title: Courses
pages.content:
Six courses, one skill each: Clear Business Writing €129, Reports People Actually Read €139, Presenting with Confidence €149, Spreadsheets from Zero €119, Spreadsheet Models for Decisions €169 and the Career Starter Bundle €329.

Lesson 1 of every course is free to watch. Access lasts 24 months from purchase.

pages.title: How it works
pages.content:
Choose a course. Watch lesson 1 free before you buy.

Buy and enrol. WooCommerce checkout gives instant access.

Learn at your table. Lessons are 8–14 minutes and available at any hour.

Practise with feedback. A tutor replies within 5 working days.

Finish with a certificate of completion, which is not an accredited qualification.

pages.title: Pricing & certificates
pages.content:
Prices are in euros. A refund is available within 14 days if fewer than 3 lessons were watched. Access lasts 24 months from purchase. Assignment feedback arrives within 5 working days.

A certificate of completion is not an accredited qualification.

pages.title: Tutors
pages.content:
Ines Carvalho co-founded Kaiten Skills in 2017 and teaches Clear Business Writing. Her lessons stay with the emails, notes and short documents people send at work.

Jonah Ellery co-founded the school and looks after the platform and learner support. Enrolment, access and questions to hello@kaiten-skills.example sit with his side of the studio.

Tomasz Wierzba teaches Presenting with Confidence, 22 lessons over a suggested 5 weeks. The course is for preparing a talk and giving it without reading the slides.

Amara Osei teaches Spreadsheets from Zero, 28 lessons over a suggested 6 weeks. It starts from a blank grid and builds toward a sheet you can keep using.

Rahul Menon teaches Spreadsheet Models for Decisions, 26 lessons over a suggested 6 weeks. The work is a simple model a team can use when it compares choices.

Sofia Marín teaches Reports People Actually Read, 20 lessons over a suggested 4 weeks. She works on structure and edits so a colleague can finish the report.

Lena Hoffmann leads learner support from the Utrecht studio. She answers Monday to Friday, 09:00–18:00 CET, and Saturday, 10:00–14:00 CET.

pages.title: Contact
pages.content:
